The band parts are printed as designators (R1/R2/C1/C2 for bands A-D) and chosen from an example table: every table row gives R1 100000 ohms, C1 0.1uF and C2 0.01uF, while R2 sets the band frequency (22 ohms to 10K) and is left as not given.
uncertain: R1, C1 and C2 of each band carry no value on the board; the values entered are the ones the example table gives for every row
